name: text
text: Nearest grid point. Parameter grids differ; missing values stay missing. Evapotranspiration energy is not converted into water depth.

name: text
text: Browse maps show regional products and dates. The application does not decode their colors into NDVI, rainfall, or field soil moisture.

name: text
text: The map’s native product grid and footprint limit what can be inferred about a small field.

name: text
text: Confidence: Insufficient evidence for a reliable confidence estimate.

Rotation scores and sensitivity methods are described in docs/methodology.md and docs/model_evaluation.md. The numeric weight bars on this slide represent the documented default weights (0.35 water, 0.25 diversity, 0.20 legume practice proxy, 0.20 preference); they are not validated effect sizes. No crop yields, probability or model confidence is presented.
